SQLite 3.46.1 amalgamation, pinned for the initial independent storage adapter.
Source: https://www.sqlite.org/2024/sqlite-amalgamation-3460100.zip
SHA256: 77823cb110929c2bcb0f5d48e4833b5c59a8a6e40cdea3936b99e199dbbe5784
Upstream source is public domain; notices are retained in sqlite3.c and headers.
This is a pinned baseline, not a claim that this is the latest SQLite release.
Built separately from Drogon ORM, with SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1.
